Coast Tranquility and Chania's Lively Pulse
Enter a head‐turning harbor of Slow Living, centered around the Greek concept of “Ef Zeen: the art of Living Well. In the elegant simplicity of suites and bungalows with private or shared pools, at the ultimate family resort in Chania Crete, dine at two exquisite restaurants, and lounge on a private beach or two sparkling swimming pools with separate adult and family areas.
Receive care at signature Soma Spa “The Refined” as children experience a unique Montessori Kids Club. Feel drawn by the energy of old Town Chania beckoning you to participate in the ongoing cultural evolution of the ancient city, awash with stories and secrets.

Discover
Design-Focused Family Stays
Earthy, award-winning suites and bungalows blend minimalist design with natural textures, timber, rattan, and vibrant local art. Private terraces open to lush gardens or spectacular Aegean sea views, some with shared or private pools. Hidden within stone alleys and tropical greenery, each sanctuary invites slow living and an authentic, soul-soothing connection to Crete’s essence for both families and couples.
Discover More
Multicultural Old Town Chania
Within walking distance, one of the oldest settlements in the world, evocative Chania is a tantalising mix of old and new, Greece’s postcard beaches, and the famous Samaria Gorge. East meets West in a blend of Ottoman, Venetian and Greek architectures, as well as Etz Hayyim synagogue, the only standing Jewish monument on Crete.
Explore the maze of cobbled alleys, artisanal arts and craft shops, noisy fair trade flea markets, and your choice of gourmet restaurants.
Discover More
Strengthen your Tribe
Concealed by the foliage, yurts and Bedouin inspired tepees compose a treehouse Neverland. Young explorers have much to discover in this one-of-a-kind Kids land; a no pressure environment for self-expression, that will keep them motivated to learn, make new friends from around the world, and spend endless hours of play while learning about a different culture.
Supervised by a Montessori inspired, highly creative, qualified OFSTED team watch children evolve into cultured, purpose-driven, sociable young tweens at Zeen Chania family hotel.
Discover More
Chef Dionysios Pliatsikas' Neo-Greek Culinary Marvels
Under the culinary wizardry of our award-winning Executive Chef Dionysios Pliatsikas, Domes Zeen Chania delights with neo-Greek cuisine, a vibrant journey across Greece’s picturesque isles. Each meal is an ode to Crete’s rich bounty, embodying the heart of the Mediterranean diet and infused with an inventive spirit.
Accompanied by a curated collection of Greece’s celebrated wines, our gastronomy is a social celebration, a crossroads of traditional influences and creative brilliance.
Discover More
AHEAD Design Awarded
Envisioned by Berlin based Lambs and Lions architects, Domes Zeen appears woven into its natural environment with an aesthetic that sparks the intuition to roam the retreat barefoot.
Designed as a traditional Greek village, the bungalows are built around a central gathering agora, paying homage to the traditional Kafeneion, the mix and mingle spot where inhabitants forge their spirit of togetherness. Domes Zeen truly defines aspired living for the unconventional, highly expressive family seeking a luxury family hotel in Grece.

A Domes Journey, Lived in Light, E-motion and Meaning
An island that offers sea and summit, energy and calm, culture and luxury, paired with a lifestyle built around wellness, motion, and generous human care. At this 5-star Family Spa Resort in Tenerife, destination and identity align effortlessly with elevated living, the Domes way.

Up to 5% off at our brand new Domes Baobab Suites in Tenerife, where sunlit suite living, outdoor athleisure, and year‑round island life come together.
Discover
Your Suite, your world
Which will be your favourite Suite? Atlantic Ocean or mountain views, spacious terraces, some with private pool and jacuzzi, or adapted Suites, the perfect Suite is waiting for you at Baobab. Our Suites are designed with a minimalist and elegant line where the wonderful light of Tenerife is the main protagonist. We welcome you to a place where you are the priority. Live an unforgettable experience in Baobab Suites.
Discover More
A privileged location
Only 5 minutes by car from the beach (with free daily transfer included in your stay), but away from the hustle and bustle of Costa Adeje, Baobab Suites offers you a privileged location: with panoramic views of the bay of Costa Adeje, its location in a quiet urbanisation will allow you to rest and relax without being far from the services of our town.
Discover More
Take care of yourself, enjoy every moment
Baobab Suites is positioned as a reference hotel for athletes and, in general, for those who consider that taking care of their body and soul is a way of life. If you are an athlete, you will love to know our facilities adapted for cyclists (from bike rental to bike maintenance workshop), or our exclusive sports club Actívate with unique services on the island of Tenerife.
Actívate, more than a fitness centre
Activate is not your average sports centre: it s an outdoor space focused on your wellbeing. From specific areas for sports rehabilitation to personal training, yoga, Pilates and Ballet Fit lessons, at Actívate you will find a place where you can keep your work-out routine, discover new disciplines and take care of yourself. Because sport is also a wonderful way to disconnect from your routine.
Discover More
Soma Spa “The Blissful”
Find your pause at Soma Spa “The Blissful” where every treatment is a carefully crafted ritual, from restorative massages and expert facials to signature journeys inspired by the volcanic landscapes of Tenerife. Powered by ELEMIS and guided by skilled therapists, your escape is created to bring out your very best.
Discover More
Baobab gastro
Because eating is a necessity but enjoying food is an art, let Baobab Suites seduce you with its gastronomic experiences. Begin your day at the fresh Bite! breakfast buffet, enjoy panoramic views at BB Lounge Club, and savour snacks at La Placita. End with gourmet flavours at Kar Bon, or dine in serene privacy with our In-Suite Gastro service included. The options are many, the pleasure of discovering them will be unique.
Discover More
Saplings Kid's Club
The youngest members of the family have their own world of fun available at Baobab Suites. A space where they can have fun, imagine and create their own perfect holiday. Because they deserve an unforgettable holiday too, don t you think?
Experience. Live. Connect. Smile
A world of experiences awaits you at Baobab Suites.
Cycling routes, hiking, scuba diving .. There is so much to do on our island!

Boutique Hotel on the Santorini Caldera | Helestia Pocket
Skip to main content
Skip to footer
Opens in a new tab
Our Mantra
A Greek way of saying life unfolds better when gently lived. Not slower for the sake of slowing down, but slower so you can feel more, notice more, remember more.
Book Now
Slow Comfort Living, Santorini Edition
Helestia Pocket Hotel is a boutique adults-only hotel on the Santorini Caldera that offers a more intimate rhythm of the island. Because luxury should not exhaust you. Because the best view in Santorini means little if you are too crowded to see it. We created a place where time softens, senses awaken, and every detail invites you back to yourself. It’s the best way to experience Santorini. Wake slowly. Watch the light move across the caldera. Wander whitewashed paths. Here, Santorini is not something to consume, but something to live through.
Take your time.
Your place in Santorini isn’t going anywhere.
Small in scale, generous in feeling. Front-row views, back-row calm. A tucked-away hideaway above the Aegean, where less becomes beautifully more.

jsonLd.name: Domes Baobab Suites Tenerife
jsonLd.description: A family-oriented all-year lifestyle and athleisure five-star resort in Costa Adeje, Tenerife, Spain. Features 125 spacious suites with private pools or Jacuzzis, 4 restaurants, 1 bar, Essentia wellness center, 4 pools (2 communal + 2 children), indoor and outdoor gym, padel court, outdoor bike studio, Kids Club, and direct access to Tenerife's coastline.
